skill.name: sast-configuration
skill.description: Configure Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools for automated vulnerability detection in application code. Use when setting up security scanning, implementing DevSecOps practices, or automating code vulnerability detection.
skill.summary: Configure SAST tools, rules, and CI gates for automated code vulnerability detection.
skill.author: wshobson

content.value_statement: Teams need repeatable security scans before code reaches production. This skill guides SAST setup, rule tuning, and CI gate configuration.
actual_capabilities: Guide Semgrep, SonarQube, and CodeQL setup decisions.
Map SAST tools to languages and CI/CD environments.
Draft baseline scanning workflows and quality gate policies.
Support custom Semgrep rule planning and false positive reduction.
Explain SARIF-compatible result handling and compliance scanning.
limitations: Does not provide executable scripts in this package.
Requires users to install and operate SAST tools separately.
Cannot validate proprietary code without repository access.
Tool versions and hosted services may change after publication.

use_cases.title: Secure a New Service
use_cases.description: Add baseline SAST scanning and quality gates before first production release.

use_cases.title: Standardize CI Security
use_cases.description: Compare Semgrep, SonarQube, and CodeQL for CI pipelines across multiple repositories.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Plan scans, reports, and remediation tracking for PCI-DSS or SOC 2 programs.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Baseline Scan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a SAST tool for a Python web app in GitHub Actions. Include first scan steps and expected findings.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Pipeline Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current SAST pipeline goals and propose blocking rules for critical issues without slowing developer feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Design Custom Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Semgrep rule plan for unsafe JWT handling in JavaScript. Include test cases and false positive controls.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Tool Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a SAST program using Semgrep, SonarQube, and CodeQL for a regulated engineering organization. Include rollout phases and governance.

output_examples.input: I need SAST for a Node.js API.
output: Recommends Semgrep for fast security rules and CodeQL for deeper JavaScript analysis.
Defines a first pipeline stage, baseline review process, and escalation path.
Lists tuning steps for generated files, tests, and documented suppressions.

output_examples.input: Our SonarQube scan creates too many issues.
output: Separates true security findings from quality noise.
Suggests language-specific profiles and quality gate thresholds.
Adds a review cycle for suppressions and recurring false positives.

output_examples.input: We need compliance scanning for PCI-DSS.
output: Maps SAST outputs to compliance evidence needs.
Recommends report retention, triage ownership, and remediation tracking.
Highlights gaps that require manual review or additional tools.

best_practices: Start with a baseline scan before enforcing blocking rules.
Tune rules with documented suppressions and regular reviews.
Use CI gates for critical security findings first.
anti_patterns: Do not block every warning during initial rollout.
Do not ignore generated code and test fixture noise.
Do not treat SAST output as complete application security coverage.

faq.question: Which SAST tools does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Semgrep, SonarQube, and CodeQL setup patterns.

faq.question: Can it create custom Semgrep rules?
faq.answer: It can guide rule design, examples, test cases, and tuning steps.

faq.question: Does it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It supports automated detection and triage, but manual review remains necessary.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan scans, evidence capture, and remediation workflows.

faq.question: Does the package include runnable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The available package contains guidance in SKILL.md only.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
